title: Gurdwara
description: The Gurdwara opens the Solstice: Sukhmani Sahib 2:00–4:00 PM, Rehras 4:00–4:30 PM, then Anand Sahib, Ardas and Hukam 4:30–5:30 PM. All are welcome.

title: Arrival & Registration
description: Have your ticket QR code and a photo ID ready. If you don't have a service exchange or karma yoga team yet, one will be assigned at check-in.

title: 🍴 Dinner
description: Served langar style.

title: Opening Circle
description: Come open the space with us! Welcome home, welcome back. Join the teachers to open this Winter Solstice Celebration with music, laughter, meditation and joy.

title: Rise up sweet family dear!
description: Wake up, get cleaned up, get ready for Sadhana!

title: Aquarian Sadhana
description: Japji Sahib, a Kundalini Yoga kriya and the Aquarian Sadhana mantras. Come as you are, bring a blanket.

title: Gurdwara
description: Gurdwara is a sacred space of Shabad (sound current), sangat (community), and seva (service). Whether this is your first time or a treasured tradition, you're invited to sit together in remembrance, sing the Naam, and bathe the mind in Gurbani kirtan. All are welcome. The Akhand Paath, the continuous reading of the Siri Guru Granth Sahib, begins at 6:30 AM.

title: All-Camp Meditation & Karma Yoga Meetings
description: A short all-camp meditation, then meet your Karma Yoga or Service Exchange team. All attendees have a karma yoga: it keeps the event sustainable and flowing. Unsure of yours? Ask at the event office.

title: Kids Camp
description: Program for children and youth while the adults are in class. Parents check children in and out. Daily schedule to be announced.

title: Raising the Heart with our Inner Sun Power
description: In these times, everyday is harder and harder to live following the heart in every situation, stress & busy lifestyle make our heart depleted & we are pushed to have our mind in control. We'll use the power of our inner sun activating and uplifting our heart, remembering the love we are.

title: Understanding the Science and Research on Yoga
description: In easy-to-understand language, this workshop will review modern biomedical research on yoga with a special focus on Kundalini Yoga. It will include the scientific evidence for how yoga works, clinical trials research, and the value and implications of yoga research in society and healthcare.

title: IKYTA Day
description: International Kundalini Yoga Teachers Association (IKYTA) session.

title: Mera Man Loche: The Soul's Longing for the Guru
description: We will explore the sacred Shabad of Guru Arjan Dev Ji, expressing the soul's deep longing for union with the Guru. Through reflection and chanting, we will connect with the essence of devotion, surrender, and the transformative power of Gurbani.

title: 🍴 Lunch
description: Free time until the afternoon program.

title: WTY Monitors Meeting
description: During lunch. Interested in being a Monitor at White Tantric Yoga® (WTY)? A WTY Monitor must have attended at least one day of WTY, wear white clothing and a white head covering, and wear the Monitor ID marker. Monitors receive the same benefits of WTY as if they were doing the meditations with a partner.

title: Sat Nam Rasayan
description: In this experience, explore Sat Nam Rasayan® through meditation, breath, and partnered healing. Develop subtle awareness, presence, and intuition while supporting your own healing and others. Experience deep relaxation, nervous system regulation, and greater clarity, peace, and inner spaciousness. All camp together, no parallel classes, with a short break at 3:30 PM.

title: Rehras
description: Evening prayer, followed by Sukhasan (Hukam, Kirtan Sohila, Ardas).

title: WTY First Timers Meeting
description: During dinner. First time at White Tantric Yoga®? Meet the WTY team and learn what to expect over the three days.

title: 3HO All-Star Music Jam
description: Enjoy an evening of devotional chanting mixed with original songs performed by a collection of your favorite Solstice musicians including Livtar Singh, Karina Skye, Japa Kaur and Sat Jot Singh.

title: Divine Mother: The Love That Holds Everything
description: A heart-centered Kundalini Yoga journey into Divine Mother love: the primal power that nourishes, protects, creates and holds life. The class is moderately active, moving from kriya into deep meditation, mantra and stillness to experience love as strength, presence and grace.

title: Morning Sadhana: Developing a Daily Practice
description: This is an inspirational class where we discuss the various types of Sadhana (40, 90, 120, 1000 days, Amrit Vela Sadhana). The benefits and challenges of it, what it takes to develop a lifelong practice. The goal is to leave students inspired to commit to a daily practice.

title: Conscious Communication within Silence
description: Step into a transformative Kundalini practice designed to deepen your inner dialogue. Through rhythmic breathwork, targeted kriyas, and silent meditation, tune out external noise, awaken vital energy, and connect to the subtle guidance of your authentic self. Silence becomes your highest wisdom.

title: Winter Solstice Glandular Summit
description: Kundalini Yoga. Be on time and ready to work! Full class of Kundalini Yoga Kriyas to prime the endocrine glandular system in perfect alignment with the winter solstice to release and rebirth at the sacred junction of the year. Ending with an extended kriya to purify sushumna and experience shuniya.

title: 🍴 Lunch

title: Rewiring Stress into Strength
description: Directing Energy with Clarity. Stress is not the enemy; it is energy looking for direction. In this class, we transform the scattered patterns of overwhelm into a focused current of strength, clarity, and inner stability. Do this with somatic intelligence, movement, mantra, breath, and intention. All camp together, no parallel classes.

title: Rejuvenate: Emotional Balance & Alertness
description: Yoga practice to stretch and exercise the body, regenerate nerves, adjust your rhythms and fine tune your frequency. A complete practice of a fun, challenging kriya, taught at full times, relaxation, and breath meditation with mantra. Love more fully, expand the universality of your personality!
